USED VEHICLE PURCHASE AGREEMENT

This Used Vehicle Purchase Agreement is between Valley Auto Sales LLC ("Dealer") and Chris Tanaka ("Buyer").

1. Vehicle. 2019 Honda Civic, VIN 2HGFC2F69KH512345, odometer reading 61,240 miles.

2. Price. The cash price is $17,900, plus tax, title and a documentary fee of $199.

3. As Is. The vehicle is sold as is, with no dealer warranty. The information on the window form for this vehicle is part of this contract.

4. Trade-In. Dealer will credit Buyer $4,000 for the trade-in vehicle.
